Messages.Author: Dan Keller
Messages.Body:
> > anything preventing that, but thematically it seems fairly odd.
>
> As odd as a Catiff becoming a Prince?

Ah, but that's a sign of Gehenna. What does a Gargoyle Prince portend?
:)

Seriously, it just seems odd that a designated "slave" could obtain any
amount of political status (i.e. control) over other "free" vampires,
especially said slave's masters. Even the ostraczied Catiff have a
nominal amount of freedom in vampiric society (e.g. they're not at
another clan's constant and immediate beck and call).

Anyway, a minor nit-pick in the greater scheme of things I guess...
